name: Argento Sartoretti
original_name: アルジェント・サルトレッティ
source:
The protagonist. A knight belonging to the guild "Pisolino Corvo."

He's called "Aruji" by those around him, shortened from his name Argento. He is sent by his guild to reclaim the abandoned inn, and becomes the innkeeper despite his actual profession as a knight.

He's a skilled swordsman with considerable experience as a guild member, yet he tends to get entangled in troublesome situations.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character07.php]official website[/url]]
